product.title: Kohala Waterfalls with Exclusive Landing Helicopter Tour

description.text: The natural wonders of the Kohala Mountains and Laupahoehoe Nui Waterfall are only reachable on foot—or by helicopter from the Kona side of the Big Island. Fly over the ever-changing landscapes of the Kohala Coast, admiring volcanic mountains, lush rainforest, and lava fields from above. Stops include Kohala Coast, Kohala Mountains, Laupahoehoe Nui Waterfall, Exclusive Waterfall Landing. Fly between 1,200-foot cliffs and land at a magnificent spot by a waterfall where you can get out to enjoy the views. Ideal for visitors basing in Kona who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
